name: Side Plank Hip Lift
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Square exercise illustration for a fitness app, readable at 280 x 280. Image 1 is the style and character reference only: same man with short dark hair, featureless face, gray T-shirt, navy shorts, white socks, gray sneakers, thin outlines, pale blue background with light circle and dark inset border. Illustrate the LOWER phase of Side Plank Hip Lift, one frozen pose. The athlete lies on his side with both straight legs stacked on top of each other. The outer side of the entire lower leg's thigh and the lower hip are resting ON the floor, with clear contact along the lower thigh; do not lift the hips or lower thigh off the floor. The upper body is propped up on the bottom forearm, with the elbow on the floor below the shoulder and forearm on the floor. Free hand on hip. Legs extend straight on floor, feet stacked. Full body front three-quarter view showing the floor contact of hip and lower thigh, the support forearm and the stacked legs. One person, anatomically coherent, no text, arrows, additional limbs or equipment.
